oncall-bot: Pager: SEV3 - billing/metering anomaly detected for us-west ingest. token_count drift +14% vs shadow for the last 10m. auto-escalating to incidents oncall.
amelia: ack — I'm oncall, jumping in now.
amelia: quick health checks — emitter-lag spikes on ingest-02, heartbeats intermittently missing.
raj: joining. can you paste a sample? I'll query the aggregation nodes and compare shadow vs live.
amelia: sample logs: ```
2026-03-17T18:12:02Z emitter=ingest-02 seq=91234 status=retry ack_id=0x7f3b
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z emitter=ingest-02 seq=91234 status=sent ack_id=0x7f3b
```
billing-bot: shadow_vs_live delta: +14.2% (us-west, 10m window). no programmatic overage rule triggered yet.
sasha: support seeing 2 customers reporting overage emails (C-102, C-231) in last 45m. not many but flagged.
jordan: hypothesis — duplicate emitter retries from proxy v2 backoff regression. could inflate token counts. recommend pausing retries on west while we confirm.
amelia: pausing emitter retries for us-west now: `/run emitter-control pause --region us-west --mode retries`
billing-bot: command accepted, emitter retries paused for us-west. metric watch started.
raj: checked aggregator logs — found ack-replay loops from proxy-v2 when upstream congestion spikes. preparing a revert of the backoff change. will roll to canary hosts first.
samir: customer-impact note: if counts are inflated we should hold billing notifications until backfill completes and counts are reconciled. please coordinate with support.
sasha: putting holds on overage emails for impacted account list in Ops dashboard now.
amelia: triggering backfill job to recompute windows (job id 20260317-mfb). command: ```
$ infra backfill --job 20260317-mfb --region us-west --window 60m --mode reconcile
```
billing-bot: backfill job 20260317-mfb started. estimated runtime ~12m. monitoring deltas.
jordan: will monitor token delta and latency. if delta < 2% after backfill, resume notifications and unpause retries. paging billing-oncall via phone. :phone:
raj: revert patch rolled to canary (2 hosts). watching for duplicate sequence entries.
amelia: update @everyone — after ~8m delta dropped from +14% to +1.8%. backfill still running but trending healthy. no new overage emails sent.
sasha: informed C-102 and C-231 that we're holding billing until reconciliation completes and we'll follow up.
amelia: handing off to postmortem owner — creating incident ticket and RCA stub. oncall to own follow-up actions (proxy revert checklist, emitter idempotency test, alert tuning).
oncall-bot: Incident created: incident-1759997777 routed to incidents and billing teams.
